'''Smooth Quartz Block''' is a block from vanilla ''Minecraft''. [[Matcha Flavoured]] adds a [[Crafting Table]] recipe (from 2 × {{MCW|Smooth Quartz Slab}}) and a [[Mud Kiln]] recipe (from [[Block of Quartz]]). See {{MCW|Smooth Quartz Block}} for everything else.
